name: app-scope-of-work-gantt-style-staircase-with-blue-day-pills
title: Scope of Work Gantt Staircase with Day Pills
whatItIs: A pale slide with a numbered Scope of work pill, a large headline, a small paragraph, a five-week header and a descending staircase of five capsules (Product Strategy, UX Research, UI Design, Interactive Prototype, Design System) each with a blue days pill, then a statement and a tilted phone on a striped ledge.
whatItMeans: A stepped capsule chart makes the schedule simple, and blue day pills make durations scannable.
techniques: Capsules stepping down across week columns
Blue pill for days inside each capsule
Bold phrases inside a large statement
Phone on a striped ledge as a closing visual

vocabulary.definition: A rounded bar representing a task in a timeline.
A small blue label with a duration in days.
